# Copilot instructions

Before any task, read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/MASTER_PROMPT.md` and `docs/PROGRESS.md`. Run the Step 0 audit from the master prompt (inspect the real repo and CI, compare with the phase checklists), tell the owner how much is done, update `docs/PROGRESS.md`, then work on the first unfinished phase. Never add automatic triggers to `.github/workflows/build.yml`.
